name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport security began unconventionally. After a brief stint in the Chilean national police, he found himself drawn to the high-octane world of racing through a chance encounter at a local rally event. The meticulous planning and risk assessment involved resonated with his natural affinity for order and detail. Recognizing a gap in security expertise tailored to the unique demands of motorsports, he pursued specialized training in track safety and crowd management.

Ricardo is developing a reputation for his comprehensive approach to security. He believes in proactive prevention, not just reactive response. He is a firm believer in understanding every potential vulnerability, from pit lane security to crowd control, and implementing robust measures to mitigate them. His demanding personality stems from a deep commitment to safety; he expects nothing less than absolute adherence to procedures.

What sets Ricardo apart is his ability to maintain a calm demeanor even under immense pressure. He has a knack for seeing the big picture, anticipating potential problems, and calmly directing his team to execute solutions. He's determined to make a name for himself in the world of motorsport security.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium build with a serious, focused expression.

quirks: Insists on reviewing security protocols multiple times before each event.
Always carries a small, well-worn notebook for jotting down observations and potential security risks.
Has a particular aversion to unsecured cable ties and considers them a major safety hazard.
